props.label: Roof Painting & Restoration
props.html:
Overview

Roof Painting & Restoration

Your roof takes the full force of Sydney’s weather, and it’s the last thing anyone looks at until it leaks. A proper roof restoration — clean, repair, re-bed and re-point, then coat — can add years to a tired roof and lift the whole look of the house. We restore and repaint both tile and metal roofs across the Inner West.

props.label: Roof restoration we do
props.html:
What’s included

Roof restoration we do

  • High-pressure roof cleaning and moss/lichen treatment
  • Re-bedding and re-pointing of ridge capping
  • Replacing cracked or broken tiles
  • Rust treatment and repair on metal & Colorbond roofs
  • Membrane and roof-grade coating systems
  • Gutter clean-out and minor repairs

props.label: Clean, repair, then coat — in that order
props.html:
Our approach

Clean, repair, then coat — in that order

A roof coating is only as good as what’s under it. We start by pressure-cleaning off years of grime, moss and chalking, then do the repairs — re-bedding and re-pointing ridge caps, swapping cracked tiles, treating rust — before we apply a sealer and two coats of a roof-grade membrane. Skip the repairs and you’re just painting over problems; we don’t work that way.

Why us

Why Inner West clients choose us for this

Inner West roofs are a real mix — terracotta and concrete tile on the old stock, Colorbond and steel on newer builds and extensions. Each needs a different prep and coating. Because roof restoration is high-value, high-difficulty work, it’s a service plenty of painters shy away from — we do it properly and stand behind it.

props.label: Section
props.html:
Good to know

Roof Painting & Restoration questions, answered

Is it worth restoring a roof instead of replacing it?
In most cases, yes. If the tiles or sheets are structurally sound, a clean, repair and recoat costs a fraction of a full re-roof, stops leaks, and dramatically improves how the house looks — often the single biggest lift to street appeal.
Can you paint a Colorbond or metal roof?
We can. Metal and Colorbond roofs are cleaned, any rust is treated and primed, and then coated with a metal-roof-grade system. It’s a great way to refresh a faded colour or change it entirely.
How long does a roof restoration take?
A typical Inner West home roof takes a few days depending on size, the amount of repair and the weather — cleaning, repairs and re-pointing, then coating once everything is sound and dry.
